tests: hidden and shown again, a window the layout floats takes the add-in's suggested size, not the layout's
a window resized by hand with the mouse takes the suggested size too when hidden and shown
steps:
This is an add-in project: building it makes a DLL that the IDE's compiler loads on every start until the DLL is removed. Install it knowingly, in an IDE you can restart, and remove it afterwards.
1. Open toolwindow-show-suggested-size.twinproj and build it for Win32. Copy Build\ToolwindowShowSuggestedSize_win32.dll into %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\ and restart the IDE. Open any project: the toolbar has a button, Show or hide the tool window.
2. Click the button. The window REPRO WINDOW floats in the middle of the IDE, 500 by 600 pixels, the size the add-in suggests.
3. Drag the window's right edge to the left and its bottom edge up, to make it about half that size.
4. Click the button twice: the window hides, then shows again at 500 by 600.
5. Close the IDE and delete ToolwindowShowSuggestedSize_win32.dll from %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\.
The same happens to a window a panel layout floats at its own size. Asserted on BETA 1042 by `addin-test.bat --only toolwindow-layouts` (the LayoutsProbe add-in in test/addin/probes/layouts, of which this project is a cut-down copy).
